description: This syllabus introduces Node.js from fundamentals through modules, asynchronous programming, Express.js, database integration, authentication, and deployment.

modules.name: Node.js Fundamentals
modules.description: Introduction to Node.js, its runtime architecture, setup, and core JavaScript concepts used in server-side development.

lessons.name: What is Node.js?
lessons.description: Understand Node.js and where it is used.

lessons.name: Node.js Features
lessons.description: Learn the major features and benefits of Node.js.

lessons.name: Node.js Architecture
lessons.description: Understand the event-driven and non-blocking architecture.

lessons.name: Installing Node.js and npm
lessons.description: Install Node.js and the Node Package Manager.

lessons.name: Running a Node.js Program
lessons.description: Create and execute a basic Node.js application.

lessons.name: Using the Node.js REPL
lessons.description: Work with the interactive Node.js REPL environment.

modules.name: Node.js Modules and npm
modules.description: Learn how Node.js organizes reusable code with modules and how npm manages project dependencies.

lessons.name: Core Modules
lessons.description: Use built-in modules provided by Node.js.

lessons.name: Local Modules
lessons.description: Create and reuse custom modules.

lessons.name: CommonJS
lessons.description: Understand require, module.exports, and CommonJS.

lessons.name: ES Modules
lessons.description: Use import and export syntax in Node.js.

lessons.name: package.json
lessons.description: Understand project metadata, scripts, and dependencies.

lessons.name: Installing Packages
lessons.description: Install production and development dependencies.

lessons.name: npm Scripts
lessons.description: Create and run reusable project commands.

modules.name: File System, Events and Asynchronous Programming
modules.description: Work with files, events, callbacks, promises, and asynchronous operations in Node.js.

lessons.name: Reading Files
lessons.description: Read file content using the fs module.

lessons.name: Writing Files
lessons.description: Create and update files using Node.js.

lessons.name: Directories and Paths
lessons.description: Work with directories and file paths.

lessons.name: EventEmitter
lessons.description: Create and handle custom events.

lessons.name: Callbacks
lessons.description: Understand callback-based asynchronous programming.

lessons.name: Promises
lessons.description: Handle asynchronous results with promises.

lessons.name: Async and Await
lessons.description: Write cleaner asynchronous code with async/await.

modules.name: Building Web Applications with Express.js
modules.description: Build RESTful web applications and APIs using Node.js and Express.js.

lessons.name: Installing Express
lessons.description: Set up Express in a Node.js project.

lessons.name: Creating an Express Server
lessons.description: Build a basic HTTP server with Express.

lessons.name: Routing
lessons.description: Create GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE routes.

lessons.name: Express Middleware
lessons.description: Understand and create middleware functions.

lessons.name: Request and Response
lessons.description: Work with request parameters, body, headers, and responses.

lessons.name: REST API Design
lessons.description: Structure RESTful endpoints for application resources.

lessons.name: Error Handling
lessons.description: Handle application and API errors consistently.

modules.name: Database Integration, Authentication and Deployment
modules.description: Connect Node.js applications to a database, implement authentication, and prepare applications for deployment.

lessons.name: Connecting to MongoDB
lessons.description: Connect a Node.js application to MongoDB.

lessons.name: Mongoose Models
lessons.description: Define schemas and models using Mongoose.

lessons.name: CRUD Operations
lessons.description: Create, read, update, and delete database records.

lessons.name: Password Hashing
lessons.description: Secure passwords using hashing techniques.

lessons.name: JWT Authentication
lessons.description: Implement token-based authentication.

lessons.name: Environment Variables
lessons.description: Protect configuration and secrets with environment variables.

lessons.name: Production Configuration
lessons.description: Prepare a Node.js application for production.

lessons.name: Logging and Error Monitoring
lessons.description: Add useful application logging and monitoring.

lessons.name: Deployment Basics
lessons.description: Understand the basic process for deploying a Node.js API.
